summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad per the spec, without committing or running tests. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gets Lambda appended at the end (asserts callable(func) with "func must be callable", stores func, call returns func(img)). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gets the typing import changed to include Callable (the only removed original line), Lambda added to the array import list, Lambdad(MapTransform) inserted after ConcatItemsd (builds one internal Lambda, applies it per key on a dict(data) copy), and the alias LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad appended after the ConcatItemsD alias. docs/source/transforms.rst gets a Lambda entry before SplitChannel and a Lambdad entry before Transform Adaptors. New tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py subclass NumpyImageTestCase2D and cover identity and slicing callables (slice [:, :, 10:50, 5:30]); the Lambdad tests cover a keys view with the sole image key and an unlisted-key preservation check. Not verified: tests, flake8, and black were not run as instructed. git diff shows the only removed line in the dictionary module is the typing import.
